Strokes of Luck Charity Golf Tournament

Date: Saturday, September 12, 13, 19, 20, 2026

Location: Westbrook Village Golf Club

Time: 8:30am

Format: 72-hole Championship Strokeplay

Cost: $150/per player, $480/foursome, $270/ per twosome

The Strokes of Luck Cup is a unique 72-hole championship that combines competitive golf with community, camaraderie, and purpose. Unlike a traditional one-day tournament, this multi-round format rewards consistency, strategy, and perseverance, giving golfers the opportunity to compete against players of similar skill levels while enjoying great courses, on-course contests, prizes, and a championship-round experience.

In 2026, the event will proudly support mental health awareness through our "Swing Against Stigma" initiative, benefiting mental health, wellness, and stigma reduction efforts. By participating, golfers are not only competing for trophies, prizes, and bragging rights, but also helping raise awareness for a cause that impacts millions of individuals and families. Join us as we compete, connect, and help break the stigma surrounding mental health, one round at a time.

Mesa City Senior

Date: Saturday, October 3rd, 2026

Location: Toka Sticks Golf Club

Time: 7:00 am Tee Times

Format: Strokeplay

Cost: $215/per player

We are excited to announce the return of a prestigious golf tradition, The Mesa City Senior Championship, to a new venue, continuing to celebrate its legacy, all while embracing the FUTURE!

For years, the Mesa City Senior Championship has been a fun and competitive event for amateurs of various handicaps who still enjoy playing in high-level golf competitions. This event, with its rich history and legacy, is being reintroduced at the renowned Toka Sticks Golf Club, and we invite you to be part of this incredible new chapter in the tournament's journey.

Open to eligible amateurs, 50 years of age and older, with a current GHIN handicap. If you do not have a GHIN, you may enter the event as a zero (0) handicap.

Outdrive Collective Open

Date: Saturday, October 10th, 2026

Location: Stonecreek Golf Club

Time: Registration at 7:00am, Shotgun Start at 8:00am

Format: 4-Person Scramble

Cost: $150/per player

Excitement is in the air! Get ready to be part of something extraordinary at OutDrive Collective's Charity Golf Tournament. It's an event like no other, and we want you to be there! 🎉

Join us for our first-ever Charity Golf Tournament on Monday, October 19th at Stonecreek Golf Club. Not only will you be golfing in great weather in Phoenix, but you will be joined by other golf enthusiasts who share the love for the game. The day includes access to the putting green and range starting at 7:00 a.m., a shotgun round of golf, an after-golf reception including an award ceremony, food and refreshments, raffle prizes, and silent auction items.

Hole-in-One Contest (Holes 5, 15), chance to win $10,000
Longest Drive Contest
Closest to the Pin
Putting Contest, chance to win $2,500

Full calendar of events:
7:00am - Registration and Warm-up
8:00am - Shotgun start
12:30pm - Backyard Cookout Lunch (included)
1pm-3pm - Awards and Prizes for Top 3 teams

1st Place - 2 signed Pat Perez golf bag stools (Valued at $2K)

3rd Place - Prize valued at $250 or more

100% of proceeds raised will go toward Dr. Rafael Fonseca's Cancer Research program at Mayo Clinic, Arizona.

About OutDrive Collective
The Outdrive Collective (a 501c(3) nonprofit organization) was founded by Andrew Kung to blend his love for golf with a mission to give back – especially to families impacted by cancer. He is passionate about harnessing the power of sport to drive meaningful change and build community. Andrew’s goal is to inspire the next generation to take the lead in supporting cures, care, and community – all while swinging for something greater.

About Mike’s Pro Barber Shop (Scottsdale, AZ)
Mike is more than just a legend and master barber – he’s a trusted voice, a mentor, and a community pillar in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area. As the owner of Mike’s Pro BarberShop, Mike has cultivated a space that goes far beyond the chair, creating a cultural hub where stories are shared, friendships are forged, and lives are uplifted. A passionate advocate for youth, families, and mental wellness, Mike uses his platform to support causes close to his heart. His hands-on leadership and unwavering dedication to community service make him a natural partner in bringing the Outdrive Open to life –uniting neighbors for a day of golf, giving, and grounded connection.

Thank you for supporting our mission; your support is invaluable!
